reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for monitoring model usage and costs, including token and cache statistics, peak/off-peak billing, balance queries, visual summaries, and report import/export.

summaries.zh: 用于 DeepSeek Harness 的用量与成本追踪插件，可记录模型调用统计、计算峰谷费用、查询余额并导出报告。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness usage and cost tracking plugin that records model-call statistics, calculates peak and off-peak charges, queries balances, and exports reports.

capabilities: Records model-call token usage, cache statistics, and calculated costs
Queries account balance through a configured DeepSeek API key
Persists usage records to local JSON storage
Imports and exports CSV, JSON, and PNG reports
Uses native file pickers and folder-opening mechanisms for exports
